concept: A price feed account that is not canonical lets users pick which valid price the protocol uses
scene: Dark navy technical card. Two stacked price account blocks feed into a single protocol box: one labelled with the latest price t2 and one with an older price t1 from a custom account. A highlighted amber arrow marks the custom account path. Clean engineering diagram style with thin lines and a small HIGH severity badge.
alt_text: Diagram of two price accounts feeding one protocol, the latest price and an older price from a custom account, with the custom account path highlighted to show a non-canonical price feed risk.
